upgrade_ram.heading: Getting more memory
upgrade_ram.body: Apple Silicon memory is soldered - you cannot add RAM later. If you are buying, the memory tier you pick is the single decision that determines which models you will ever run.

storage.heading: Somewhere to keep the weights
storage.body: Model files are large and Apple's internal storage is expensive. A fast external SSD over Thunderbolt loads weights quickly enough that you will not notice the difference.

voice.heading: For voice assistants
voice.body: If you are running a local speech pipeline, a decent USB microphone changes transcription accuracy far more than a bigger Whisper model does.

cooling.heading: Sustained load
cooling.body: A laptop under continuous inference will throttle. A cooling stand costs little and keeps long generation runs at full clocks.
